saniabidjan: Sanitation Facility Management in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, 2018 — saniabidjan
text: tibble 207 rows 25 variables area_name Identify survey areas, options including (1) Abobo (2) Yopougon. sex Indicates respondents gender, options including (1) female (2) male. education Level education respondents, options including (1) : respondent go school, (2) primary: respondent elementary level, (3) coranic: respondent went Quranic school, (4) high school: respondent high school degree, (5) graduate: respondent university degree. housing_type Description accommodation unit respondent lives, options including (1) common courtyard (2) individual. status Indicates respondent homeowner , options including (1) free host: respondent hosted free, (2) owner: respondent homeowner, (3) renter: respondent renter. lat_facilities surveyed household latrine facilities? facilities_loc Specifies exact location latrine household, options including (1) house, (2) yard, (3) yard. facilities_type Describes type latrine used household, options including (1) pit latrine, (2) improved latrine, (3) public latrine. lat_sharing Explains latrines used household nb_user Reveals number users latrines. impacts_of_sharing Indication respondent perceives use latrines, options including (1) hygiene problems, (2) problems, (3) vulnerable disease, (4) waiting line. lat_care Gives overview people charge latrine cleaning, options including (1) , (2) care, (3) private person, (4) round turn. clean_freq_wk Specifies cleaning frequency latrines household. tank_presence surveyed household septic tank? tank_location Specifies exact location septic tank household, options including (1) court yard, (2) court yard, (3) know. latrines_nb Reveals number latrines connecting septic tank. tk_status Expresses septic tank performance status. empty_freq_yr Indicates number times septic tank emptied year household, options including (1) 1, (2) 2 (3) 3. empty_mode Indicates septic tank emptied household, options including (1) emptying truck, (2) manual emptying, (3) truck manual. empty_price Shows charge/price (CFA franc) emptying septic tank. wastwat_dispos Show whether household wastewater disposal facilities, options including (1) courtyard, (2) open drain, (3) street. waste_cont surveyed household solid waste disposal facilities? waste_cont_loc Precise location solid waste disposal equipment, options including (1) courtyard (2) courtyard. cont_empty_wk Indicates emptying frequency solid waste disposal equipment per week common_ill Overview common disease household associated sanitation, options including (1) diarrhea, (2) infections, (3) malaria, (4) typhoid fever.
